name: Shaggy Wombat 39
author: PriyanshuGupta28
description: Gradient rounded blue button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px 19px 38px, #000000 0px 15px 12px, transform becomes translate(5%, 20%), width becomes 110%.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Shaggy Wombat 39</title>
<style>
/* Shaggy Wombat 39 by PriyanshuGupta28 — https://uiverse.io/PriyanshuGupta28/shaggy-wombat-39 */
.button {
  all: unset;
  width: 100px;
  height: 30px;
  font-size: 16px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  position: relative;
  color: #f0f0f0;
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 1;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  transition: 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.button:hover {
  box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 19px 38px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22) 0px 15px 12px;
}

.button::after,
.button::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: -99999;
  transition: all .4s;
}

.button::before {
  transform: translate(0%, 0%);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #4158D0;
  background-image: linear-gradient(43deg, #4158D0 0%, #C850C0 46%, #FFCC70 100%);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.button::after {
  transform: translate(10px, 10px);
  width: 35px;
  height: 35px;
  background: #6804da2f;
  backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
  border-radius: 50px;
}

.button:hover::before {
  transform: translate(5%, 20%);
  width: 110%;
  height: 110%;
}

.button:hover::after {
  border-radius: 10px;
  transform: translate(0, 0);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.button:active::after {
  transition: 0s;
  transform: translate(0, 5%);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button role="button" class="button">Hover Me</button>

</body>
</html>
